{npc:The Orc King} guards a treasure in his throne room, protected by the best warriors of the {wiki:Orc Fortress}. Fight your way through the fortress, pass the level 40 door and open the quest boxes at the far north of the throne room to receive a {item:Knight Armor}, a {item:Knight Axe} and a {item:Fire Sword}.
The Orc King hoards a treasure in his throne room, guarded by the fortress's best warriors.
Orc King's throne room (where the boxes are)
Level 40 to pass the {item:Gate of Expertise} (50+ recommended).
No required items; bring enough potions and runes for many orcs
recommended for climbing back up through the entrance hole
**Do not say {key:hi} to {npc:The Orc King}** until you have the reward: he summons many orcs of all kinds, including Berserkers, Leaders and Warlords.

If you have started the {wiki:Blue Djinn Quest}, the {wiki:Green Djinn Quest} or the part of the {wiki:Jester Outfits Quest} where you have to give an {item:Exploding Cookie} to the Orc King, take advantage of this visit: first pick up the reward and only then talk to him.

Go to the {wiki:Orc Fortress} ({wiki:Ulderek's Rock}), which is **north** of Venore and **east** of Ab'Dendriel: take the boat to **Venore** (for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais: {key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes}) and walk **north** to the fortress. Enter through the hole marked on the map.
Map of the Orc Fortress with the entrance hole
Head **east**, ready to face all kinds of orcs. The safest path is marked with a blue line on the map.

Go down the stairs. At the bottom you will face several {creature:Orc Leader|Orc Leaders}, {creature:Orc Warlord|Orc Warlords}, a {creature:Dragon} and probably some {creature:Orc Shaman|Orc Shamans} and {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems}, coming from a room **west** of the stairs.
The Dragon and the Orc Warlords hit hard: pull them one at a time if you can.
When they are all dead, go **east** and then **north**, passing the level 40 {item:Gate of Expertise}.
Map of the path to the throne room

This room has several {creature:Orc Berserker|Orc Berserkers}, {creature:Orc Warlord|Orc Warlords}, {creature:Slime|Slimes}, {creature:Orc Leader|Orc Leaders} and {creature:Orc Rider|Orc Riders}. {npc:The Orc King} is also here, an NPC that looks like a Defiler.
Do NOT say {key:hi} to the Orc King: he summons many orcs of all kinds.
The quest chests are at the far **north** of this room. Open them to receive the {item:Knight Armor}, the {item:Knight Axe} and the {item:Fire Sword}.
Knight Armor, Knight Axe and Fire Sword

If you are doing the {wiki:Blue Djinn Quest}, the {wiki:Green Djinn Quest} or the {wiki:Jester Outfits Quest} mission with the {item:Exploding Cookie}, only now, after you have the reward, say {key:hi} to {npc:The Orc King} and complete those missions. Get ready for the orcs he summons.

Go back the same way: pass the level 40 door again, go up the stairs and return along the blue line on the map to the hole where you came in; climb up it with a {item:Rope}. Then walk back **south** to Venore.
The orcs move in large groups and respawn: do not stop to rest near the fortress.
